data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate had higher overall loss ratios than its Syndicate Business Forecast, with the 2015 year of account suffering deterioration in respect of new claims notified, particularly attritional hull claims.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Deterioration in respect of new claims notified, particularly attritional hull claims, contributing to adverse development on the 2015 year of account.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported adverse reserve development in relation to the 2015 year of account. The 2015 year deteriorated primarily due to newly notified attritional hull claims, producing a gross strengthening of reserves of approximately GBP 15.0m. The 2016 year has shown higher attritional cargo claims but the principal prior-year movement relates to the 2015 underwriting year.
raw_causal_phrases: the 2015 year of account suffering deterioration in respect of new claims notified, particularly attritional hull claims.
The 2016 year of account has experienced higher attritional cargo claims.
We incurred eight losses in excess of US$0.5 million of which five were in the cargo class.
Our exposure to catastrophes has been low, with only two of the larger claims resulting from windstorm damage.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (15.044m) was derived by comparing the gross claims outstanding at 31/12/2015 (balance sheet total 6,328k) to the gross outstanding attributed to the 2015 underwriting year at 31/12/2016 (21,372k) as shown in the gross claims development table. There is no separate explicit 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure. The claims development triangle contains only two underwriting years (2015 and 2016); the movement therefore was computed from the available breakdown. No specific named catastrophe events were quantified. All monetary conversions to millions performed from reported GBP '000 amounts.
